description_en: Stops one or more running cloud computers. After the operation is called, the cloud computers enter the Stopped state
description_zh: 停止一台或者多台运行中的云电脑。接口调用成功后，云电脑进入已停止状态
kebab_example: aliyun ecd stop-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-7w78ozhjcwa3u0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The billing mode after the cloud computers are stopped
parameters.name: stopped_mode

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a patch update when an update is ready. A value of true indicates that the patch update is performed
parameters.help_zh: 在更新已就绪的前提下，是否执行补丁更新。为true表示执行补丁更新
parameters.name: os_update

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create a snapshot
parameters.name: create_snapshot
